en.description: TOR330 - Tor des Géants is a ultramarathon. Location: Courmayeur, Italy. Date: 13 September 2026 – 19 September 2026. Distances: 330 km. Entry fee: check with the organiser. The map below shows the host town; check the organiser for the exact start line.
